All four annotations share the prefix `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-`. The controller dispatch annotation is `aws-load-balancer-type: external` — without it, the in-tree controller ignores your other annotations and provisions a Classic ELB instead.
`spec.type` must be exactly `LoadBalancer` (capital L and B). `ClusterIP` or `NodePort` never provision a cloud load balancer, regardless of annotations.

The cross-zone annotation value must be the string `"true"` (quoted in YAML), not the boolean `true`. YAML booleans and strings are different types — the verifier does a string comparison against `"true"`.
